turns.question: For outreach messages sent between 20 September and 3 October 2026 that got a reply, what was the 75th percentile of hours between the message and the reply?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the time from message to reply, so I cannot give a 75th percentile of hours. The closest metrics are Messages replied (outreach messages that got a reply, counted on the day they were sent) and Reply rate (share of outreach messages that got a reply, counted on the day they were sent).
